mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) triggers Federal Reserve accommodative policy responses, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity valuations for positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal expanding residential construction activity that precedes broader economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.5%) forces the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in unemployment (UNRATE) and increases in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicate a tight labor market that elevates consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.
